_purpose: Campaign constants for the NPR supplementary study. Hyperparameters are NOT duplicated here: they come from results/reference/train_args_c40_vid.json, the same file V8 used, so the two campaigns cannot drift apart. This file records only what is specific to the NPR campaign.

order._note: Committed BEFORE training, per the prespecification. Always training arm A first would let an order effect load onto one arm. 'a_first' trains xception then NPR; 'b_first' is the reverse. This controls a POSSIBLE ORDER EFFECT ONLY -- no mechanism (heat, caching, memory fragmentation) has been tested and none may be claimed.

session_rule: Each seed's two arms must complete within one session. A pair split across sessions stays recorded but is excluded from the primary paired analysis, and both arms are rerun together in a new session.

_cost_estimate._status: ESTIMATE ONLY, extrapolated from the five V8 xception runs. The prespecification requires timing one NPR epoch before the full campaign (docs/npr_run.py --time-one-epoch).

_analysis_gate: src.campaign_gate must pass before any bootstrap. The analysis entry points glob for dumps, so a pattern reaching results/predictions_v8/ would mix sessions silently.
